reported_result: Leaf extract reduced glucose-associated cell loss up to 30 micrograms/mL; protection was absent at 100 micrograms/mL.
source_rationale: Ethanol leaf extract protected high-glucose-exposed PC12-AC cells through 30 µg/mL, but showed no protection at 100 µg/mL. Different concentration-specific results justify a conditional, not uniformly favourable, finding.
